Wetland.name: Rainwater Basin Wetland Complex Watershed Restorations WFL1
Wetland.snippet: Rainwater Basin wetland restorations that include irrigation re-use or concentration pit fills.  Watershed restorations involve filling irrigation re-use pits previously associated with gravity irrigation.  Pits within historic wetland footprints were usually designed to concentrate water within the wetland allowing the de-watered portion of the footprint to be used for agricultural purposes.  Concentration pits were often used for gravity irrigation water re-use, as well.  However, most irrigation within the region has been converted to center pivot irrigation, making re-use pits obsolete.  Remnant irrigation re-use pits reduce wetland function by intercepting water from rainfall that may otherwise accumulate within wetlands.
